audit.whatIsWrong: Three level-chart rows disagreed with the packet chart AND with the whys already on the page: index 2 was Kayle (packet: Skill), index 4 was Vayne (packet: Kayle), index 6 was Kayle (packet: Vayne).
audit.why: whys[2] literally says 'a genuine coin-flip skill window', whys[4] says 'you own the post-6 window', whys[6] says 'the hard scaler reclaims the late game'. The sides contradicted their own text.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Vayne — proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present and accurate: Vayne levels 2-3, Kayle level 6, Kayle first item, Vayne 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; phase whys now name the same drivers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn and Tumble were referenced everywhere with zero numbers, and Tumble's auto-attack reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s — a 20s rank-1 window is long enough to build a whole trade around. Tumble is 6/5/4/3/2s and resets her auto, so the wind-up (not the cast) is the tell that a three-stack Silver Bolts proc is coming.
audit.corrected: Added Condemn 20s rank 1, Tumble 6s rank 1 + auto-reset wind-up tell, and the keep-terrain-off-your-back rule for the Condemn stun.

audit.why: Boilerplate gendering leaked from the template.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the strings edited here; the rest are template-shared and flagged in notes.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You are melee with no escape and she Tumbles in (a 6s auto reset) to stack Silver Bolts true damage — last-hit and give her nothing.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: Q-poke softens her step-ups while you scale. Condemn is 20s at rank 1 — that is your window to step up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vayne must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online — you out-poke a stack-less Vayne, she out-trades a full three-stack proc. A coin-flip until 6.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown and bank small leads. Keep a wall out of your back so a pin cannot stun you.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged with AoE waves and Divine Judgment blanks her Tumble-and-burst commit — pop it as she starts the Silver Bolts stack.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's on-hit out-DPS an item-starved Vayne — all-in while Tumble is down, 6s at rank 1.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' percent-HP true damage ignores every resist you scale — she reclaims this. Close before her third item.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — 20s at rank 1, wall-stun. Keep terrain off your back. - Tumble: 6s at rank 1, resets her auto — the wind-up is the tell. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 20s at rank 1, a wall-stun — engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Vayne wastes Condemn — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Her Tumble wind-up is the tell — step back on it, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her three-item spike is real — CS is the only thing that beats it.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Condemn: 20s at rank 1, wall-stun. Tumble resets her auto, 6s at rank 1 — read the wind-up.

edits.before: Wave-by-wave: farm safe, E-poke Vayne when his answer is down, and let levels 6 and 11 renegotiate the lane.
edits.after: Wave-by-wave: farm safe, Q-poke Vayne when Condemn is down, and let levels 6 and 11 renegotiate the lane.

notes: Packet flagged 'Two Silver Bolts' and 'Her Silver Bolts' as suspect names — both are FALSE POSITIVES, Silver Bolts is Vayne's real W. Kayle's R is invulnerability; the kit file tags it 'untargetable'. The existing text says R 'cancels'/'blanks' her burst, which is true for damage, but I did not claim it dodges the Condemn displacement itself — unverified. Several template-shared strings (breakdown.trading, report[3], report[12], dosFull[1].d, breakdown.feeding) still call Vayne 'his'/'he'; they are duplicated boilerplate and would need a global pronoun pass rather than per-matchup edits.
